notes.title: Wishlist Umbra Fields today!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2652040/Umbra_Fields/

No matter what you choose, and what you do, you will have an impact upon the world. Do you wish to be a criminal, or a savior? That is up to you.

Choose between 13 distinct classes:

Warrior: A well balanced with a focus on strength. Made to do any quests.

Doctor: Healers that can heal the sickness across each nation, yet are weak on their own.

Thief: Shopkeepers never sell to them, with their moves constantly under watch. Going to The Prison, is the least of the thief's worries.

Hunter: They live for the hunt and the slaughter. They can be found to get good pay from hunting rare beasts.

Rune Master: The old and intelligent beings that can read cosmic words.

Summoner: They can summon creatures to protect themselves. Hated by most, they are targeted for creating abominations upon the world.

Ice Spearmen: Fishermen who fish whenever they can find any remaining, clean water.

Investigator: A detective that can use guns, talk to enemies when able, and can take on cases for others. If you are cunning enough, some will join you by speech alone.

Priest: The Gods need priests to spread their holy words, teaching them holy magic. 

Brute: A Warrior that has no honor, fierce in the wild, yet cannot live among civilization.

Storm Evoker: The Forbidden one was one of these, a being that can control the storms. The outcasts worship Evokers, others fear them.

Fowler: Flying beasts that can travel to any place they please, but are hunted.

Fire Elemental: Due to the Great War, The Flame has made all Fire Elemental to be worshiped and adored. Yet not all feel the same way.



Whatever you become, you shall be the prey of others from man to beast. Master who you are and what you will become to manage your stamina, hit weaknesses, stun enemies, and kill to survive. Do quests to get stronger, to learn more to use more magics and skills.

Choose your nation:

The Flame: A land of The Flame, an active volcano where Fire Elementals are born.

The Land of the Sea: A land once known for it's Ice, it has become melted to be a grand Sea.

The Grand Tree: The last of nature, all connected to the Mother Tree.

Angelic Constabulary: A land for the last of the an holy order that wants to maintain law.

The Prison: Those who break the law are sent to the Prison to rot, while it's controlled by a Mafia.

Lich Fields: Sky islands full of the rot and sickness where Wizards and Summoners roam free.

Pig Nation: A nation isolated from the rest after The Great War, run by the pigs who have no God.

No Man's Land: The only thing that connects the nations together, only the outcasts live here and the beasts roam free.

notes.title: Leap to the Top+ has released!
notes.content:
Game link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2604970/Leap_to_the_Top/

You are a frog, every second. You can control your movements only while jumping, or charging a super jump. With this simplicity, it takes seconds to learn how to play, but a very long time to fully master each stage.

There are seven stages, each with their own unique boss battles and stage mechanics. One stage will have you use switches to open parts of the stage up, while opening new threats, Another will be about timing, hiding behind pillars. Each stage takes time to learn and master. Once you beat a stage, look at your time and try to get a better one with your newfound mastery.

Every stage outside of the final stage has 5 hidden coins to collect for true completion. Some can be gotten with special movements made to teach and test the player, some require going out of the way to get them. Coins are always interesting and fun to collect, and getting all 30 unlocks the final stage.

[b]Can you Leap to the Top?[/b]

notes.title: Cyber Prison Management has just launched, buy it now!
notes.content:
Cyber Prison Management has just launched, buy it now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2530080/Cyber_Prison_Management/

Welcome to Cyber Prison Management, a colony sim where you are tasked with managing 8 prisoners in a flying space prison for 30 days, only with your shocks, security bot, and camera system. You’ll need to manage goods in the market, defend the prison from hostile ships, and manage your prisoners to keep them in line in order to survive. Or you may wish to play as one of the prisoners, trying to hide from the system managing it, and trying to escape. But be careful - danger is always around the corner.
[b]SYSTEM AI MODE[/b]
[list][*]Control and manage the prisoners using the camera system and tools available.
[*]Maintain Prisoner compliance, mood, sanity, and more. They may start murdering each other, or worse, if not maintained. 
[*]Create toys to sell for cash, and use the cash to invest in goods like Fuel, Food, and Ammo to survive.
[*]Buy and trade with other ships along the journey with a dynamic and always changing market and market prices.
[*]Use the ship's turrets to fight off hostile enemy ships trying to stop you.
[*]Choose your actions carefully, while trying to be concealed and hidden with your true intentions while getting stopped for inspections.
[*]Can you survive all 30 days to reach the destination?[/list]
[b]PRISONER MODE[/b]
[list]
[*] Control a prisoner being watched by the Ship's System AI through the cameras.
[*]Manage the prisoner's mood, sanity, hunger, pee level, fear level, and more to survive.
[*] Interact with other prisoners and objects to survive and to further your chance for survival.
[*]Evade the cameras to escape Shocks and Solitary when disobeying orders.
[*]Sabotage the ship's supplies, security bot and more while also making sure there is enough to survive.
[*]Can you escape in 30 days or less?
[/list]

notes.title: Arcade Mode has been added!
notes.content:
Arcade Mode has been added!

New content: Arcade mode available in the mode select menu.

>Most bosses and enemies from the main game is added into this mode to constantly put you on your feet.

>Every HP pickup costs one coin.

>Every upgrade has a cost of 5 coins outside the starting upgrade.

>The more coins you have, the more aggressive enemies will be and the more enemies prepare for you. Do you try to not collect many coins to have less upgrades, or should be you greedy at the cost of stronger threats?

Can you beat this new mode? This is 100 rooms of terror, how far can you go? This mode was made for people who wanted a more arcade like experience with a twist. More content may be coming in the future.

notes.title: Purchase Hell Trigger now!
notes.content:
Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475890/Hell_Trigger/

You are Unit ***, a soldier who was tasked to do a yearly expedition to The Flesh by The Authority, the government that rules over all. Your Mission: Find and gather data about The Heart of The Flesh, and why it is eating up all of humanity.

Fight your way through The Flesh, an always changing living dungeon! The dungeon is alive in this horror inspired rouge like, the dungeon warps to your actions, sending it's evil creatures to go for the hunt.

A bullet hell to test your limits. Every encounter will test your skill. Will you be able to gather the pieces from fallen soldiers to be strong enough to get closer to The Heart? Only those who master their movement and dashing can survive... Even when you die, another Unit will replace you the following year.


Purchases upgrades and save money in a bank for future runs. But only if you can get that far. Only those who can use what they find and fight their way through can get access to specialty shops to help with future runs. All rewards come with a cost.

6 areas to die in total. Each stronger than the last. Each area has new enemies and new bosses, with new mechanics made for one reason: to make you die. Will you become skilled enough to get far, or fall deep into The Flesh as a corpse?

Are you ready to die? Your expected survival rate is 0%, unless maybe you are skilled and lucky enough to survive.

notes.title: Buy and play Mythical Agent today!
notes.content:
Buy now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2432630/Mythical_Agent/


You play as Agent Urassik, a secret agent who was fighting his arch rival, General Lei, when the end of the world occurred. You wake up in Diyu, the realm of the dead, where you meet Lord Yama, the king of hell. He recruits you as the leader of Unit 7, an anti-terrorist organization that fights against demons and other threats in the capital city of Youdu and beyond. You will have to use your skills and tactics to survive and complete your missions. You will also have to manage your team of misfits, each with their own personality and backstory. You can bond with them during free time events, learn more about them, and influence their behavior and loyalty. Your choices will matter and change the game in subtle or major ways. You will also face Lord Zepar, a powerful and mysterious enemy who has a sinister plan for Diyu. Will you be able to stop him and find a way back to the living world? Will you discover the truth behind the apocalypse and your destiny? Will you find love or betrayal in the underworld? The choice is yours in Mythical Agent, the strategy role-playing game that has 12 main endings!

Explore the lives and personalities of your companions. In this game, you fight in a variety of missions that will test your tactical skills and strategic thinking. But the action doesn't end there. After each mission, you can also enjoy some free time with the characters you have met and befriended along the way. You can hang out with them and chat with them. You can learn more about their backgrounds, motivations, secrets, and dreams. You can also influence how they view you and how they behave in future missions. Your choices will also affect how the random NPCs in the game world react to you and your team. Will they respect you, fear you, love you, or hate you? Will they help you, hinder you, or ignore you?

In this game, you are not just a passive observer of a predefined story, but an active participant who can influence and change the course of events. Every decision you make, every dialogue option you choose, every battle you win or lose, every ally you recruit or betray, every item you use or discard, every skill you learn or ignore, every secret you discover or hide, will have an impact on the story, the cast, and the path you follow. You will face realistic and meaningful consequences for your actions, both positive and negative. Some may be immediate and obvious, while others may be delayed and subtle. Some may be minor and personal, while others may be major and global. You will never know what to expect in Mythical Agent, the strategy role-playing game that adapts to your choices!

Mythical Agent is a strategy role-playing game that offers you unparalleled freedom and replayability. In this game, you can choose from nine different main paths, each with their own missions chosen from your actions with Urassik. Everything you do is counted and will impact the story, characters and the world is subtle or massive ways! Each path will lead you to different locations, quests, allies, enemies, and endings. No two playthroughs will be the same in Mythical Agent, the strategy role-playing game that lets you shape your own destiny!

But the missions are not linear or predetermined. They have multiple outcomes, depending on what you choose to do. You can complete the missions in different ways, such as stealth, combat, diplomacy, sabotage, or deception. You can also make moral choices that will affect the lives of the people involved. Your choices will have consequences, both immediate and long-term. They will also impact what options you have in future missions. You may unlock new paths, gain new allies, lose old ones, or face new enemies. You may also change the political and social landscape of the world. Nothing is set in stone. There are 100 Achievements to collect, meaning there are 50-100 hours worth of content. 

But with great freedom comes great responsibility. How will you use your freedom? Will you be a hero or a villain? Will you save the world or destroy it? Will you make friends or enemies? Will you follow the rules or break them? The choice is yours: what will you do?
